item.title: Iran appreciates Russia and China for their principled stances and for vetoing US anti-Iran resolution
item.description: New York, IRNA – The Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations expressed appreciation to Russia and China for their negative votes—which blocked the US-sponsored anti-Iran resolution—and to Pakistan and Somalia for their abstentions, as well as for the principled and valuable stances taken by these nations.
item.content:encoded:

New York, IRNA – The Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations expressed appreciation to Russia and China for their negative votes—which blocked the US-sponsored anti-Iran resolution—and to Pakistan and Somalia for their abstentions, as well as for the principled and valuable stances taken by these nations.

item.title: Iran stresses effective implementation of global treaty on genetic resources and traditional knowledge
item.description: London, IRNA — The Deputy Permanent Representative of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Geneva described the global treaty on genetic resources and traditional knowledge as a significant step toward establishing a more transparent and balanced international intellectual property system, and emphasized the necessity of its effective implementation.

London, IRNA — The Deputy Permanent Representative of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Geneva described the global treaty on genetic resources and traditional knowledge as a significant step toward establishing a more transparent and balanced international intellectual property system, and emphasized the necessity of its effective implementation.

item.title: Foreign Ministry summons German ambassador over Berlin’s anti-Iran positions
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has summoned the German ambassador in Tehran to protest the positions of senior German officials against Iran and the interventionist actions of the German embassy.

item.title: Hollywood-style Shows cannot mask US war crimes: Iran’s London embassy
item.description: London, IRNA — The Iranian Embassy in London has posted a tragic video of the burial scene of the ‘Minab’ school children martyred in a US missile attack, slamming the US war crimes as so blatant that they cannot be concealed by “Hollywood-style movies produced by the US Secretary of War.”

item.title: Tehran orders Swedish diplomat to leave Iran within 48 hours
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rejected Sweden’s allegations against the Islamic Republic and ordered a Swedish diplomat in Tehran to leave the country within 48 hours in response to Stockholm’s decision to prevent an Iranian diplomat from continuing his duties in Sweden.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86266666/Tehran-orders-Swedish-diplomat-to-leave-Iran-within-48-hours

Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rejected Sweden’s allegations against the Islamic Republic and ordered a Swedish diplomat in Tehran to leave the country within 48 hours in response to Stockholm’s decision to prevent an Iranian diplomat from continuing his duties in Sweden.
